title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (June 2026)
summary: This is a Hacker News monthly hiring thread where companies can post job opportunities to the HN community. The post sets guidelines for job postings including location requirements (REMOTE/ONSITE), verification that posters must be actual company employees, and rules against recruiting firms posting.
problem_solved: Connects tech companies with potential hires through a trusted community platform with clear posting standards.
why_valuable: HN hiring threads have historically been a source of high-quality candidates and interesting opportunities from startups and established tech companies alike.
